text: International Economics and Trade is an undergraduate major in ordinary institutions of higher learning in China, belonging to the category of economics and trade. The code for this major is 020401, and the duration of study is four years. Upon completion, students will be awarded a Bachelor of Economics degree. Here is a detailed introduction: Professional Overview: This major mainly focuses on the study of basic knowledge and skills in economics principles, international economy, international trade, etc. It aims to enable students to understand the current environment and development status of China's foreign trade and contemporary international economic and trade. Students will also become familiar with international trade rules, laws and conventions, as well as China's foreign trade policies and regulations. Subsequently, they will be able to engage in import and export business and foreign economic and trade activities.Training Objectives: To cultivate application-oriented, multi-disciplinary, and internationalized talents with good moral character and ethical standards. They should have a systematic grasp of the basic knowledge and theories of economics and trade studies, be familiar with international trade rules, be proficient in using a foreign language and modern information technology, possess excellent communication, coordination, and innovation capabilities, and have an entrepreneurial spirit.
